column1: # Hades II on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Supergiant Games' engine on NVN, update v655360 (1.0.141667, SDK 20.5.15), 55 shaders, all translated. On the Y700 (2026-10-27): boot, the title, a new save,
# the opening, the Crossroads and runs in Erebus with combat, driven with DM_CTL and played by hand by the user with a controller (GameSir G8+), who saw and heard
# nothing wrong at the end. 60 fps held as on the Switch: frame p50 16.6 ms, p95 about 19 ms, a few dropped frames per 300 in heavy combat; replay about 3 ms and
# GPU 6-7 ms a frame, footprint about 2.2 GB, no audio underruns, no red log line. Three core fixes came with it (gfx_vk_tex.c lin_copy, gfx_vk_exec.c fdz and the
# touch after a command-buffer cut): its glyph atlas, title art and Bink movie planes are linear textures the CPU writes in place (all text and the title art were
# blank); its lights went dark for single frames while walking near them and went out in turn every 24-48 frames when standing.

column2: v655360 Lenovo Legion Y700 TB322FC (Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, Android 16)
